title: Khaman Dhokla
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
steps: Prepare a smooth batter with besan, yogurt, water, and salt.
Add Eno/fruit salt just before steaming and mix gently.
Steam the batter in a greased pan for 15-20 minutes.
Prepare a tempering with mustard seeds, sesame, curry leaves, and green chillies.
Pour the tempering over the cooled dhokla and cut into squares.

fullIngredients.name: 1 tsp Eno/fruit salt or baking soda
Turmeric, sugar, salt, green chilli-ginger paste
Mustard seeds, sesame, curry leaves, green chillies for tempering

tipsList.title: Tip 1
tipsList.desc: Soft, spongy texture comes from the leavening and proper steaming.

tipsList.title: Tip 2
tipsList.desc: A quintessential breakfast and snack item in Gujarati-influenced cuisine.

title: Dal Dhokli
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
steps: Boil the toor dal until soft and mash it well.
Knead wheat flour with spices and oil to make a stiff dough.
Roll the dough into thin rotis and cut into diamond shapes (dhokli).
Prepare a spicy dal with tomatoes, jaggery, tamarind, and peanuts.
Drop the dhokli pieces into the boiling dal and simmer until cooked through.

fullIngredients.name: Turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin

tipsList.title: Tip 1
tipsList.desc: Comfort food that combines dal and wheat pieces.

tipsList.title: Tip 2
tipsList.desc: Slightly sweet-tangy flavour is characteristic of Gujarati-style cooking.

title: Ubadiyu (Gujarati Barbecue)
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
steps: Prepare a paste of garlic, green chillies, ginger, and coriander.
Stuff the paste into the vegetables (eggplants, potatoes).
Layer the vegetables and beans inside an earthen pot.
Seal the pot with cabbage or banana leaves.
Roast slowly over a wood fire or charcoal until tender.

fullIngredients.name: Garlic paste, green chilli paste, ginger paste

tipsList.title: Tip 1
tipsList.desc: The dish is unique for its fragrance and earthiness from kalar (Indian nettle) and kamboi (black honey shrub) .

tipsList.title: Tip 2
tipsList.desc: Best enjoyed during winter when ingredients are in season .

title: Traditional Fish Curry
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
steps: Clean the fish and marinate with a pinch of turmeric.
Prepare a base paste with onion, ginger, garlic, and spices.
Heat oil, temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Add the spice paste and sauté, then add coconut milk and tamarind.
Simmer the fish gently in the curry until cooked.

fullIngredients.name: Fresh fish (seer, pomfret, or local catch)
Turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder

tipsList.title: Tip 1
tipsList.desc: Fish is a staple food in Daman and Diu, available fresh from the Arabian Sea .

tipsList.title: Tip 2
tipsList.desc: The Portuguese influence adds unique preparation methods distinct from other Indian coastal cuisines .

title: Crab Curry
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
steps: Clean and crack the fresh crab pieces.
Sauté onions, ginger, garlic, and tomatoes until soft.
Add turmeric, red chilli powder, and crab pieces.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer gently.
Cook until the crab shells turn vibrant red and the meat is cooked.

tipsList.title: Tip 1
tipsList.desc: Crab is traditionally eaten by hand to facilitate extraction of meat .

tipsList.title: Tip 2
tipsList.desc: A common dish in Daman and Diu reflecting the Portuguese influence on local cuisine .

title: Patra ni Macchi
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
steps: Marinate fish fillets with salt and lemon juice.
Prepare a green chutney using coconut, coriander, mint, garlic, and green chillies.
Coat each fish fillet generously with the green chutney.
Wrap the coated fish securely in banana leaves.
Steam for 15-20 minutes until the fish is flaky and cooked.

tipsList.title: Tip 1
tipsList.desc: The banana leaf wrapping keeps the fish moist and infuses it with a subtle aroma .

tipsList.title: Tip 2
tipsList.desc: Represents the sophisticated seafood preparation influenced by Parsi and Portuguese traditions .

title: Salli Boti
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
steps: Marinate mutton pieces with ginger-garlic paste and salt.
Sauté onions until golden, then add tomatoes and spices.
Add the mutton and cook slowly until tender.
Reduce the gravy until rich and thick.
Serve hot topped generously with crispy potato straws (salli).

tipsList.title: Tip 1
tipsList.desc: The crispy potato straws (salli) add a delightful crunch to the rich, tangy gravy .

tipsList.title: Tip 2
tipsList.desc: Combines Persian cooking methods with local ingredients.

title: Vindaloo
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
steps: Marinate pork in vinegar, garlic, ginger, and ground spices overnight.
Heat oil and fry onions until deep brown.
Add the marinated pork and sear well on all sides.
Add a little water and simmer slowly until the meat is very tender.
Adjust seasoning; the curry should be spicy and tangy.

tipsList.title: Tip 2
tipsList.desc: The Portuguese colonial influence on Daman and Diu's cuisine is strongly reflected in this dish.

title: Bebinca
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
steps: Prepare a batter of coconut milk, egg yolks, sugar, flour, and nutmeg.
Grease a deep pan with ghee and heat it.
Pour a thin layer of batter and bake/broil until cooked and golden brown.
Add more ghee, pour the next layer, and repeat the process.
Continue layering until all batter is used; cool before slicing.

tipsList.title: Tip 1
tipsList.desc: A Portuguese legacy still thriving in Daman and Diu's culinary scene .
